enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Head on pillow. Body covered with blanket. Breathing regularly. Occasionally shift legs. Turn head to side. Adjust arm position. Remain still. Sleeping.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower lid. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Rinse toothbrush. Put toothbrush back. Wipe mouth with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl, plate, glass. Close cupboard. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs with fork. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Stir eggs with spatula. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Toast bread in toaster. Spread butter on toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat eggs and toast. Drink milk. Stand up. Carry dishes to sink. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Select shirt and pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to bathroom. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Return to bedroom. Pick up work bag. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleagues. Walk to office. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Check emails.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Answer phone. Talk to patient. Take notes. Walk to examination room. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Examine patient. Take blood pressure. Record data. Remove gloves. Wash hands. Walk to nurses' station. Discuss with colleague. Type on computer. Attend meeting. Eat lunch. Return to desk. Make phone calls. Update patient records. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk back to desk. Sit down. Continue working.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Take off shoes. Walk to kitchen.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Cook meat. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Clear table. Carry dishes to sink. Wash dishes. Dry dishes. Put dishes away. Wipe counter. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and leisure activities (watching TV, using computer)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Browse internet. Check social media. Watch video. Put down laptop. Pick up phone. Send text message. Play game on phone. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to living room. Sit down. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down (reading or listening to music)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Turn on lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn pages. Put down book. Pick up phone. Open music app. Select song. Put on headphones. Listen to music. Lie down. Close eyes. Remove headphones. Put phone on nightstand. Turn off lamp.
Lie in bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
